fields.name: Is_there_pre_work
fields.helpText: Check this box if your program contains any pre-work

fields.name: Do_you_need_audit_access
fields.helpText: Audit access allows the client to log in directly to the LMS to monitor registrations, grades, and progress in real time.

fields.name: Upgrade_Excel_Grader
fields.helpText: Please check this box if you need the Excel Grader included in your course. There is a fee associated with this product so please be sure the client/CSM/RM is aware before adding this to the course.

fields.name: Upgrade_Data_Dashboard
fields.helpText: Please check this box if you will require a Data Dashboard after this delivery. On the last day of training, someone from the eLearning team will reach out to you with next steps.

fields.name: Do_you_need_Certificates
fields.helpText: Please check this box if you will need certificates to be created and distributed to learners after this program.

fields.name: Certificate_Title
fields.helpText: Please type your desired certificate title – once these certificates are dispatched, we will be unable to make any changes.

fields.name: Select_Type_s_of_Pre_work
fields.helpText: Please select all categories of pre-work you will be using. To select mutliple options, press Ctrl Key and hit enter.

fields.name: SmartPath_Pre_Assessment
fields.helpText:
V1 = Typical FT audience

V2 = Typical Intern audience

fields.name: SmartPath_Soft_Deadline_Recommended
fields.helpText: The eLearning team will include this deadline in the pre-work instructions, but the exam will not actually close or forbid late submissions.

fields.name: SmartPath_Hard_Deadline
fields.helpText: The eLearning team will include this deadline in the pre-work instructions as well as the exam configuration so that students will be completely unable to submit after the deadline.

fields.name: Pre_work_Self_Study_Options
fields.helpText: Select all courses that need to be made available as pre-work (required or optional). Learners will have access to any courses chosen here immediately upon registration. To select muliple options, press Ctrl Key and hit enter.

fields.name: Pre_work_Self_Study_Special_Instructions
fields.helpText: Please include any special instructions you would like included such as what items are required vs. optional. There is a standardized order that these courses will appear for learners that gradually increases in complexity, but if you have a specific order in mind please include those details here.

fields.name: Pre_work_Diagnostics_Exam_s
fields.helpText: Select any of the exams you will be using. If you are doing something custom, please select that option and reach out to the product team as soon as possible to ensure there are no delays.

fields.name: Pre_work_Diagnostics_Exam_s_Instructions
fields.helpText: If you have any special instructions please include them here.

fields.name: Custom_Additional_Pre_work_Instructions
fields.helpText: If you have anything else you think the eLearning team needs to know about the pre-work of this program please include it here.

fields.name: Course_Categories
fields.helpText: Please select the overall topic covered in this program. This simplifies the initial request process and helps improve our internal reporting.

fields.name: Legacy_AMT_Materials_Q1_2024_Only
fields.helpText: This box should be ticked if you are using legacy AMT Materials in any capacity.

fields.name: Legacy_TTS_Materials_Q1_2024_Only
fields.helpText: This box should be ticked if you are using legacy TTS Materials in any capacity.

fields.name: Legacy_Marquee_Materials
fields.helpText: This box should be ticked if you are using legacy Marquee Materials in any capacity.

fields.name: Custom_Materials
fields.helpText: This box should be ticked if you are using any sort of custom materials that will be preped and maintained by the eLearning Team.

fields.name: Self_Study_Not_pre_work
fields.helpText: Select all courses that will accompany the delivery. Courses chosen in this section will appear for learners on day 1 of the program.
